zh_CN: 电极片位置错误，请按照图示重新贴放
en: Incorrect pad placement. Reposition the pads as shown.
condition: Simulator placement assessment explicitly reports the two chest pad positions swapped
source: User clarification: chest pad positions interchanged, not reversed cable polarity
trigger: On entry into the invalid-placement condition; do not repeat on every position update
recovery: After placement is corrected and the therapy path is valid, request a fresh analysis; do not resume a stale Ready state
